app_fee.value: Every graduate applicant pays a $50 application fee when applying.
app_fee.quote: A $50 application fee is required upon applying.

fee_waiver.value: The fetched Graduate Studies pages mention no fee waiver; departments differ (see program records).

gre_general.value: The Graduate Studies pages leave the GRE to each program; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT overall 4.5 on the new scale from January 21, 2026, with at least 4.0 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (internet-based test) | NEW SCORING as of January 21, 2026: Minimum sub-scores of at least 4.0 in Listening, Reading, Speaking, and Writing, comprising an overall score of at least 4.5.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band 7.0, with at least 6.0 in each module.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list, so Indian applicants need an English test score.
english_waiver.quote: Generally, all applicants are required to demonstrate an acceptable level of English language proficiency in order to satisfy the university requirements for graduate admission, unless an applicable exemption or waiver applies. | Only applicants who are citizens of the following countries (or those applicants who have received a residential bachelor's degree or higher from said countries, within the previous 24 months of the intended start date of their respective graduate program) are 'exempt' from this requirement.

notes: Built from the Graduate Studies international applicants and English proficiency pages. Graduate Studies program pages (gradstudies.byu.edu/<program>-phd) and the Coursedog program catalog failed through the proxy (ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED or 502), so program-level facts come from department pages. Some department pages still quote the old TOEFL 85 iBT minimum; not used here. The English page says some departments may require higher scores.
